arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox', event_id, json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status <> 'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'booking', booking_id, json_object('request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference) FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold', hold_id, json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache

SELECT 'booking_backing' AS kind, b.booking_id AS id, json_object('status',b.status,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charges',(SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured'),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status <> 'confirmed' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents) <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.flight_id=b.flight_id AND c.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',event_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'capacity',f.flight_id,json_object('capacity',f.capacity,'holds',count(h.booking_id)) FROM flights f LEFT JOIN holds h ON h.flight_id=f.flight_id GROUP BY f.flight_id
